reset_password.subject: Your password reset code
reset_password.body:
Hello {username},

your code to reset your password is:

    {code}

It is valid for {minutes} minutes. If you didn't ask for a new password, ignore this email; your password stays as it is.
reset_password.@body: Keep {code} on its own line, indented by four spaces, so it stands out.

verify_email.subject: Confirm your email address
verify_email.body:
Hello {username},

your code to confirm your email address is:

    {code}

It is valid for {minutes} minutes. If you didn't create an account, ignore this email.
verify_email.@body: Keep {code} on its own line, indented by four spaces, so it stands out.

change_email.subject: Confirm your new email address
change_email.body:
Hello {username},

your code to make this your account's email address is:

    {code}

It is valid for {minutes} minutes. If you didn't ask for this change, ignore this email; nothing changes.
change_email.@body: Keep {code} on its own line, indented by four spaces, so it stands out. The mail goes to the new address.
